text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're here for the Kinko Sho. Matikanefukukitaru, our rival for today, arrives at the scene decked out head-to-toe in lucky goods.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inspired by Mihono Bourbon, she refers to herself as "Full Armor Fukukitaru." However, this is far from being a joke.
